body.name: Positive-real covariance twin set \(\mathcal E_p(G,G')\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal E_p(G,G')=\{\theta\in\mathcal M_{p,q}(G):\exists\theta'\in\mathcal M_{p,q}(G')\text{ with }\Sigma_{\theta'}^{(k)}=\Sigma_{\theta}^{(k)}\text{ for every }k\in K\}\). Candidate baseline and intervention variances are positive but may satisfy \(t'_k=v'_k\); variance activity is imposed only on a true theorem-specific generic locus.
